headline: Reviews split on Gears of War: E-Day despite strong combat
summary: Reviews of the Xbox prequel Gears of War: E-Day agree its combat is the strongest in the series, continuing the franchise's focus on tense, brutal action. But verdicts on the game as a whole diverge: one review calls it a great game, while another finds everything surrounding the combat disappointing.

claims.statement: Reviews single out E-Day's combat as the strongest part of the game, continuing the series' core action.

sources.quote: E-Day boasts the best combat in 20 years of Gears games
a brutal, tense, and self-aware action game, one that is stronger because it doesn't deviate from that premise

discrepancies.explanation: The Verge judges E-Day a great game overall, while The Guardian finds everything surrounding its combat disappointing.

quotes.quote: Gears of War: E-Day is a great game launching at a terrible time
but everything surrounding it is disappointing
